question.text: Class A unit holder in Example 3 (Fund TM) sold 3,00,000 units at LTCG tax 12.5% on Rs. 6.75 crore gain. Total LTCG tax (incl. 15% surcharge + 4% cess) ≈ ?

explanation.text: The Logic: Tax = 84.37 lakh. Surcharge 15% = 12.66 lakh. Cess 4% = 3.88 lakh. Total = Rs. 1.01 crore. The Trap: Other values miss surcharge/cess add-on. Cross-Exam Context: Directly from Example 3. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Use this format in client tax disclosure for unit transfers.
